```python
def solve(case):
    nodes = case["nodes"]
    required_symbols = set(case["required_symbols"])
    
    # Build children map
    children = {node["id"]: [] for node in nodes}
    for node in nodes:
        if node["parent"] is not None:
            children[node["parent"]].append(node["id"])
    
    # Sort nodes: deeper first, tie-break by node ID (lexicographic)
    sorted_nodes = sorted(nodes, key=lambda n: (-n["depth"], n["id"]))
    
    # Track retained set
    retained = {node["id"] for node in nodes}
    removed_order = []
    
    for node in sorted_nodes:
        nid = node["id"]
        
        # Must be removable
        if not node["removable"]:
            continue
        
        # Must not have retained children
        if any(child in retained for child in children[nid]):
            continue
        
        # Tentatively remove: check if all required symbols still represented
        retained.discard(nid)
        
        # Check required symbols coverage
        retained_symbols = {n["symbol"] for n in nodes if n["id"] in retained}
        
        if required_symbols.issubset(retained_symbols):
            # Keep removed
            removed_order.append(nid)
        else:
            # Restore
            retained.add(nid)
    
    retained_sorted = sorted(retained)
    
    return {
        "removed_node_ids": removed_order,
        "retained_node_ids": retained_sorted
    }
```
